description.value: The Statue of Liberty walking tour is a half-day trip to Liberty Island, reached only by the authorized Statue City Cruises ferry. Boats leave from Battery Park in Manhattan or Liberty State Park in New Jersey. Ferry tickets include the island museums, and pedestal or crown access costs extra.
